address: 29 Ratchawong Road, Chang Moi, Mueang Chiang Mai, Chiang Mai, 50300, Thailand
bio: Every day at lunch long lines form in front of this decades-old shop selling Hakka-style noodles. House-made Hakka stuffed tofu, fish sausage and crispy wontons find their way into every dish including tom yum noodles and the classic Yentafo. The latter is highly recommended, with a well-seasoned soup made from fermented bean curd and fresh chilli....
